Pilots To The Rescue is a nonprofit, volunteer-driven organization dedicated to saving animals by air. We transport at-risk dogs, cats, wildlife, and farm animals from overcrowded or under-resourced shelters to rescue partners and adoption centers where they have a real chance at life.

On this channel, you’ll go behind the scenes of real rescue missions... inside the cockpit, on the tarmac, and at shelters across the country. You’ll meet the animals whose lives are changed forever, the pilots and volunteers who make these missions possible, and the rescue partners working tirelessly on the ground.

Whether it’s a last-minute emergency transport, disaster response, or a freedom flight years in the making, our goal is always the same: move animals to safety and give them the futures they deserve.

Subscribe to follow our life-saving missions and be part of a community that believes love, and hope can fly.
